mentions.name: RankCompass
mentions.description: A free rank list tool for medical trainees that balances logical factors with gut ranking, and includes pairwise comparisons, maps, and other decision aids for building ordered lists. Potential future use cases include picking housing and other decisions that require ordered lists.
mentions.problem: Balancing logical factors and gut ranking when creating ordered rank lists.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm making a site of free tools for medical trainees, the biggest being a rank list tool to balance logical factors and gut ranking as well as pairwise comparisons/maps/etc. 
https://medcompass.tools/rankcompass
